p: O LORD: I did not put my trust in any worldly thing.
trust in thee: That you will take away my enemies, which are your rods.
Shew me thy ways: Retain me in the faith of your promise that I swore not on any side.
all the day: Constantly and against all temptations.
sins of my youth: He confesses that his many sins were the reason that his enemies persecuted him, desiring that the cause of the evil may be taken away, so that the effect may cease.
teach sinners in the way: That is, call them to repentance.
guide in judgment: He will govern and comfort them that are truly humbled for their sins.
name's sake: For no other respect.
man is he that feareth the: Meaning, the number is very small.
choose: He will direct such with his spirit to follow the right way.
ease: He will prosper both in spiritual and corporal things.
secret of the LORD is with: His counsel contained in his word, by which he declares that he is the protector of the faithful.
are enlarged: My grief is increased because of my enemies cruelty.
enemies: The greater that his afflictions were and the more that his enemies increased, the more near he felt God's help.
integrity and uprightness preserve me: As I have behaved myself uprightly toward my enemies, let them know that you are the defender of my just cause.
